events.summary: Worcester 20s & 30s 2nd Annual Hostel Takeover Weekend in the White Mountains

description.plain:
Friday, June 26, 2026 | 8:00 PM
https://activities.outdoors.org/s/oc-activity/a5UVX00000152yH2AQ/
Join the Worcester Chapter 20s & 30s for a weekend of outdoor fun in the White Mountains June 26-29 for the second annual Hostel Takeover! This year’s theme is…aliens! Expect the theme to crop up throughout the trip; participation in it is optional!The trip runs from the evening of Friday, June 26 through Monday, June 29. A variety of hiking and socializing opportunities will be offered each day as we explore several regions of the White Mountains. At least two hiking options, one moderate and one vigorous, will be provided each day (for rating definitions, go here). Specific offerings will be determined by leaders that weekend depending on participant ability and conditions. Hikes will be in the immediate area and possibly others farther afield. After the days’ hikes, we will all return to the Conway Hostel (CoHo), our basecamp for the weekend. The trip includes three nights’ lodging at CoHo, where you will find all the comforts you are looking for after a long hike– shared bunk rooms, private bathrooms, a shared kitchen with full access, and shared space for socializing. A group dinner will be included and served on Saturday and Sunday evening, and CoHo offers free coffee, tea, and granola bars for breakfasts. Friday night dinner will be an optional potluck. Breakfast (other than what the hostel offers) and lunches not included. Evening activities will be offered, possibilities including a movie screening, star gazing, fire pit, and games. The hostel is also a ~5 minute walk away from the Saco River where swimming is allowed.Cost is $170 for AMC members ($185 for non-members) per person for 3 nights at CoHo and 2 dinners. If the cost of this trip is an obstacle for you being able to attend, please reach out to one of the registration leaders (Alexandra at amusic@verizon.net or Dirk at dirkauman@gmail.com), as we have limited subsidy options available. Refunds are not guaranteed and are dependent on someone taking your spot if this event reaches full capacity. Once you register for the trip here, one of the leaders will send a screening form to gather further information to ensure the trip will be safe and fun for all participants. Payment will be collected once your spot on the trip has been confirmed.Gear is available for loan through the Worcester Chapter Gear Shed for those who may need it. As an affinity group within AMC that is dedicated to encouraging people in their 20s and 30s to enjoy the outdoors, this is a trip for those in their 20s and 30s.
